messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — auth-proxy observed unusual token replay pattern from several IPs. Potential leaked tokens in logstream. Auto page to #incidents and oncall team.
emma: Oncall here, ack. Starting triage. Which env affected?
raj: Seeing the spike on auth-proxy-1 in prod-us-east-1. ~1200 token reuse hits in last 10m, many 401->200 transitions.
dana: Security here. Correlating with recent log-forwarder deploy. Tagging @legal for potential PII concern.
leo: Tail logs: ip set: 34.98.12.4, 54.33.99.201, 3.120.5.67. Pattern looks like token replay across endpoints. Query:
```
index=auth-prod earliest=-15m | stats count by src_ip, user_agent, token_prefix
```
raj: Can confirm unusual user_agent 'okhttp/4.9' across many hits. Also small number of requests included 'x-debug-id' header — likely from staging forwarder misroute.
emma: If staging log forwarder leaked token snippets to prod logs then rotate affected tokens ASAP. Dana / Raj please scope which service accounts.
dana: Initial find: one staging svcacct (svc-telemetry) had long-lived token and appeared in forwarded logs at 09:12UTC. Recommend immediate rotation of svc-telemetry and any tokens with same prefix. Legal: @legal please advise on customer notification threshold.
legal: Reviewing. If tokens allow read of customer data we'll need to follow breach policy. For now collect scope. Retain evidence, don't delete logs.
raj: Kicking off key rotation: creating new creds for svc-telemetry, updating KMS access. Patch ETA ~10m. Running targeted revoke for tokens with prefix 'st-9f3a'.
emma: Deploy a quick WAF block for those three IPs and add rate-limit rule on auth-proxy. Also disable log-forwarder to prod until we confirm config.
leo: Applying ip block + rate limits now. Confirmed block for 34.98.12.4 and 54.33.99.201. Rate-limit rule applied.
ops-bot: :gear: Action executed: ip-block applied (34.98.12.4,54.33.99.201) by leo. Rate-limit rule ID rl-2026-07 applied.
dana: Running token scan across logs to find any other occurrences. If tokens leaked to external bucket we'll escalate. Current scan found 14 unique token fragments; 9 match svc-telemetry prefix.
emma: Customer impact check: any active sessions from these tokens? Raj?
raj: Some replay hits succeeded against internal-only endpoints — no direct external customer data reads seen so far. Monitoring DMARC and outbound logs for exfil.
dana: We should disable any long-lived staging tokens and rotate pipeline credentials used by log-forwarder; patch config to avoid prod target.
emma: Who's owning postmortem? I can own and coordinate write-up. Dana, Raj, Leo, Legal as reviewers. We'll set follow-up meeting.
dana: I'll prepare incident severity and recommended mitigations for postmortem. Also we need to add detection rule to alert on token-prefix reuse patterns.
emma: TL;DR: contained — ip blocks + rate limits + rotated svc-telemetry keys + disabled log-forwarder -> monitoring. Next: postmortem, detection rule, legal review.
raj: Rotation complete. New credentials deployed. Rolling token blacklist applied.
legal: Holding for final scope — no customer PII exfil detected at this time. Will advise on next steps in 2h.
emma: Closing thread for now. If anything new shows up, reopen. :white_check_mark:
